# Comparison tables for module C (generated by experiments/analyzeC.py)

Time = median of 5 runs after one warm-up, with the interquartile range (IQR). ops = operations as defined in the README (comparisons + moves + probes + windows examined + table cells + subsets). mem = peak memory beyond the input. Objective: count for greedy, value for dp, dpquad and brute.
